# Public drawing pilot provenance

These original files are unchanged public-domain engineering illustrations.
The source description pages were checked on 2026-09-23. Each page identifies
a copyright-holder public-domain dedication. SHA-256 identities are pinned in
manifest.json and validated before the benchmark reads the assets.

| Local file | Author | Source and licence declaration |
| --- | --- | --- |
| hole.png | Borowski, 2006 | [Technical Drawing Hole 04](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Technical_Drawing_Hole_04.png) |
| section.svg | Pallas, 2008 | [Klad przesuniety Technical drawing](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Klad_przesuniety_Technical_drawing.svg) |
| bracket.png | Greudin, 2004; corrections by Erik Baas, 2009 | [Engineering drawing-dessin de definition](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Engineering_drawing-dessin_de_definition.png) |

The historical local name bracket.png refers to a turned-part drawing, not a
bracket. Labels were manually selected from visible boundaries/text and SVG
coordinates, independently of detector output. They are **partial**, not a
complete expert-labelled reference set. Raster coordinate tolerances allow
stroke width and manual placement; they are not manufacturing tolerances.

Generated skew/blur and bilingual hybrid-PDF variants are benchmark augmentations.
Chinese/English titles were added by this project; they are not annotations from
the original public drawing. DPI metadata is not a real scanner acquisition.
No private user PDF, DWG, screenshots or acceptance database is redistributed.
